```mjs title=main.mjs
import { __webpack_require__ } from "./runtime.mjs";
var __commonJS = (factory, flags, id, isEntry, module) => function __require() {
	if (module !== undefined) {
		return module.exports;
	}
	module = { exports: {} };
	if (isEntry) module.isEntry = true;
	if (flags & 1) module.id = id;
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = false;
	if (flags & 4) factory.call(module.exports, module, module.exports, undefined);
	else factory(module, module.exports, undefined);
	if (flags & 2) module.loaded = true;
	return module.exports;
};
var require_a = /*#__PURE__*/ __commonJS(function(module, exports) {

/*!**********************!*\
  !*** ./modules/a.js ***!
  \**********************/
module.exports = { value: "a" };

}, 0, "./modules/a.js");

/*!**********************!*\
  !*** ./modules/b.js ***!
  \**********************/

}, 0, "./modules/b.js");

function __rspack_context_load(id) {
  switch (id) {
		case "./modules/a.js": return require_a();
		case "./modules/b.js": return require_b();
    default: throw new Error("Unknown context module '" + id + "'");
  }
}

var map = {
  "./a.js": "./modules/a.js",
  "./b.js": "./modules/b.js"
};



function __rspack_async_context(req) {
  return __rspack_async_context_resolve(req).then((id) => (__rspack_context_load(id)));
}
function __rspack_async_context_resolve(req) {
  // Here Promise.resolve().then() is used instead of new Promise() to prevent
  // uncaught exception popping up in devtools
  return Promise.resolve().then(() => {
if(!__webpack_require__.o(map, req)) {
  var e = new Error("Cannot find module '" + req + "'");
  e.code = 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND';
  throw e;
}
return map[req];
});
}

var require_modules_weak_nonrecursive__js$ = /*#__PURE__*/ __commonJS(function(module, exports) {

/*!*******************************************!*\
  !*** ./modules|weak|nonrecursive|/\.js$/ ***!
  \*******************************************/
function __rspack_context_load(id) {
  switch (id) {
		case "./modules/a.js": return require_a();
		case "./modules/b.js": return require_b();
    default: throw new Error("Unknown context module '" + id + "'");
  }

function __rspack_context_module_available(id) {
  switch (id) {
    case "./modules/a.js": case "./modules/b.js": return true;
    default: return false;
  }
}

var map = {
  "./a.js": "./modules/a.js",
  "./b.js": "./modules/b.js"
};


function __rspack_context_module(req) {
  var id = __rspack_context_module_resolve(req);
  if(!__rspack_context_module_available(id)) {
    var e = new Error("Module '" + req + "' ('" + id + "') is not available (weak dependency)");
    e.code = 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND';
    throw e;
  }
  return __rspack_context_load(id);
}
function __rspack_context_module_resolve(req) {

    var e = new Error("Cannot find module '" + req + "'");
    e.code = 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND';
    throw e;
  }
  return map[req];

// ./index.js
const context = require__js$();
const eagerContext = require_();
const weakContext = require_modules_weak_nonrecursive__js$();

it("should link a synchronous context through local initializers", () => {
	expect(context.keys().sort()).toEqual(["./a.js", "./b.js"]);
	expect(context.resolve("./a.js")).toContain("./modules/a.js");
	expect(context("./a.js").value).toBe("a");
	expect(context("./b.js").value).toBe("b");
});

it("should preserve resolve semantics for eager and weak contexts", async () => {
	expect(await eagerContext.resolve("./a.js")).toContain("./modules/a.js");
	expect((await eagerContext("./a.js")).value).toBe("a");
	expect(weakContext.resolve("./b.js")).toContain("./modules/b.js");
	expect(weakContext("./b.js").value).toBe("b");
});

export {};
```

```mjs title=runtime.mjs
// The require scope
var __webpack_require__ = {};

// webpack/runtime/has_own_property
(() => {
__webpack_require__.o = (obj, prop) => (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj, prop))
})();

export { __webpack_require__ };

```
